summary: Iter8 verified both changes in the TIMEUP batch: (1) dedicated admin login isolation and admin-only routing, and (2) daily streak reward bumped to 20 coins. Backend pytest: 3/3 passed (admin login role, streak GET/claim credits +20 to fresh user, admin login role check). Frontend Playwright drove real UI: admin/login → /admin with 'Admin Console' header + Sign out, no user Navbar/BottomNav; admin visiting /home and /wallet is redirected back to /admin; /admin/login has no country selector and no Register link; unauth /admin redirects to /admin/login; admin credentials submitted on /login are rejected with 'Invalid credentials.' and remain on /login; fresh registered user lands on /home with user shell and is redirected to /admin/login when navigating to /admin. All 6 requested features PASS.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration console warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (className on <option> triggers a wrapper <span>). Cosmetic only, does not block flow. Already flagged in iter7.

action_items: OPTIONAL (pre-existing): remove className on the <option> children in Login.js line 54 and Register.js line 56 to silence hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute isolation is correct: admin-role on user routes redirects to /admin, unauth on admin routes redirects to /admin/login, non-admin on admin routes redirects to /admin/login. Good separation.
AdminLogin.js correctly logs out non-admin roles after login attempt via /admin/login, preventing back-door admin.

Login.js correctly rejects admin-role users at the client with a generic 'Invalid credentials.' message; note the token is briefly issued by /api/auth/login before logout()  — acceptable UX but could be tightened server-side by an explicit admin-block toggle for /login if desired.
Backend streak_config.daily_bonus=20 is honored by both GET /api/streak and POST /api/streak/claim; claim credits exactly +20 to bonus wallet.
